query: What do Motorola Moto G Power (2022) reviews say about screen clarity, brightness, and touchscreen reliability?
search_text: What do ) reviews say about screen clarity, brightness, and touchscreen reliability?

rows.text: Gone are the touch screen buttons at the bottom to navigate between screens. Instead, everything is based on swiping from the bottom or sides, which is only about 50% accurate (at least when the phone is in a case with a screen protector. The good stuff: Thumbprint unlock works pretty well. Display is very vivid, although not nearly as bright- hard to see in bright sunlight or with sunglasses on even at max brightness.
Other than mediocre screen brightness, it’s amazing!. Don’t think you can beat this phone at this price point.

Screen brightness is dim. I like the phone but my one complaint is the screen brightness. On previous phones I have the screen brightness turned nearly all the way down but with this one I have to have it at least half for the same brightness. The problem is when it is bright outside, even with the brightness all the way up, it's hard to see what's on the screen.
Touchscreen unresponsive about 30% of the time.. Touchscreen unresponsive about 30% of the time. Never had smartphone be so glitchy. What a fail. No wonder it was cheap. Extra star for good battery.

There's another good thing about it, but that's highly subjective. The brightness goes a lot lower than other phones, and PWM flicker is insignificant (as opposed to say, Google Pixel 5a). It makes it easier to look at, for those with sensitive eyes. But G7 Power also had high PWM refresh rates and a decent brightness range. I can't believe that the phone with less RAM and slower CPU feels like an upgrade to this 2021 model - reads fingerprints flawlessly, launches apps faster. What the hell, Motorola?

This 662 scores over 200,000 on the AnTuTu benchmark, 30,000 higher than the 665. Even better, they apparently fixed the cheap memory, and by reducing the screen resolution the graphics load is a much better match for the Adreno 610. This is a case of major addition by subtraction. And the screen is noticeably bigger. Re: the screen, it took a lot of lumps in review for being 720p, but I think it's actually better in color and readability than the 2020 screen - plus it's noticeably bigger. And it goes really bright - I find it has a wider brightness range than the 2020. Similarly, the only difference between a 2021 plastic frame and a 2020 metal frame is that it's lighter. I guarantee you will not notice a strength difference, just that is a bigger phone that feels lighter.

Disappointing screen brightness outdoors. Upgraded from a Moto G5 plus and noticed at full brightness levels (settings) it was had to see outdoors. Indoors very acceptable. Apart from that it seems a nice upgrade but I'll be looking more closely at brightness levels for future purchases.

The screen seems to turn dark in the sunlight. In bright sun it is impossible to see even at full bright. I just turned on adaptive brightness. I had to set it brighter for indoors and it automatically went to full bright outdoors but the sun isn’t shining today. The signal and call quality is the only thing that makes this phone a keeper. If that had not been such an improvement I couldn’t justify the higher cost of this phone.

A decent phone. I've come to realize that Motorola is fairly reliable although it is not my dream phone it is a pretty good phone for the money the battery life ends at 7:30 p.m. because I use bright screen all day because I need that so it's not a 3 Day battery for me also the fingerprint reader is not very good so I can't use it because it's on the back of the phone and the Samsung I had before has a fingerprint inside the screen which was great other than that I can't say enough good things about Motorola being reliable although I wish they hadn't promised me a three day battery life because that's what I was really looking for the price was reasonable and even though it was a used phone it came looking like new!

Reliable, great battery life. One thing I can say is that the phone is reliable and has an amazing battery. The 2020 version was the best phone ever for the price. Unfortunately the 2021 version is a downgrade from the 2020. Screen freezes up constantly, calls drop for no reason, and if you ever want to play a game forget it that freezes up too. But after owning this phone for over a year it is reliable. I would however recommend the 2020 if you want a g power.
3 day battery, huh?. 3 day battery? Maybe if you turn the screen brightness all the way down and you don't touch the damn thing!

Never had a single issue with my previous phone with the back cover fingerprint. But this power button fingerprint has hiccups. I had to add the thumb to it because it stopped registering my index finger which was the first finger I had to set up. The brightness of the screen is terrible. Have to have it on full bright most of the time which drains battery. If your outside you can hardly see the screen on middle brightness. Overall I like the phone. Got it for sale on $229 so couldn't pass that up. If you don't mind some features that are not as good as the original phones then you'll be happy with this purchase. I do find that this phone takes better pictures then my brother's $800 iphone so that's a plus.

Photos taken 6 ft no zoom do not have good clarity or detail. The coolest or most practical perk is the fingerprint reader. It's actually the side power button so you can adjust it to any way you might pick up the phone, which is very convenient and doesn't add anything extra to the back of the phone. Despite its "paper" quality, the screen is dull and lackluster. As for gaming, I play only simple interactive games like Food Street and Covet Fashion, however, even on those the loading time is lagging a bit so I would guess it's not great for people who play full action or games with heavy graphics.
Beautiful phone!. Beautiful big bright screen, takes awesome pictures, and very fast. Excellent battery life. Can’t ask for more. Priced right and highly recommended!

Decent Phone for the Price. This phone was definitely surprising for the price. Decent enough performance. The screen resolution is actually 720p and not 1080p like the answers say. HD+ just means slightly larger than 720p resolution. I learned that post having the phone and had to return because I stream a lot of videos and want 1080p for a backup phone.

If you want more than a phone, keep scrolling. The good news first... the battery life is great. That's it for the good news. The phone's gyroscope does bot work correcy which means the screen will randomly turn off because the phone can't tell if it is in use or on standby. If you are trying to make a call, play a game or read text messages, it's a crap shoot if the screen will remain on or if you will be able to jiggle it to the exact random positioning needed to turn the display back on. If you don't need reliability, this phone is for you
Battery life. I use this product for texting, calling and group messaging. I also like the picture clarity. The slim design is a great fit for my hand. Best of all the battery life.

Solid. Solid phone for someone on a budget, the battery is very good and the build quality has a nice premium feel to it. The screen is big and bright and the speakers are loud. It's not a flagship by any means but that's not what you should expect in this price range.

4 of these in my household, great value. I primarily care about reliability. I have stayed with the G Power for 3 or 4 years now, my entire household has them. After 3 years one had an issue where the screen started to fuzz out, so I replaced it with a new model. These phones have been worry free for us on t-mobile and att. Aside from that old phone, the others are now 2-3 years old and seem to take a beating fine. I should note that after seeing bad reviews of the 2022 version, I replaced the old phone with the screen issue with a 2021. Fingerprint on the side works great for me. I use a poetic case, fits great and leaves the fingerprint exposed for easy use. Thanks to Motorola for keeping budget-friendly unlocked phones on the market.

not a great phone, but not all the way awful.. I bought this phone after my samsung note 9 broke and wow, what a world of difference there is between these two phones. This moto phone has a pretty weak screen; the brightness is absolute trash, don't try looking at your phone when you're outside and there's sunlight, you won't be able to see the screen at all, it's really bad. Want to watch movies? I hope you like potato quality, because this screen can barely do HD and you can visibly see the lag and screen tearing on faster videos. If those things are important to you, I would not recommend this phone. The response time is pretty slow. It's almost a full 3 seconds after I press an app button, that the apps will actually open.
